mapper.select: SELECT * FROM model_config WHERE page_type = #{pageType} AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE model_config SET folder_path = #{folderPath}, display_name = #{displayName}, model_name = #{modelName}, model_type = #{modelType}, is_active = #{isActive}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_config (config_key, config_value, description) VALUES (#{key}, #{value}, #{description}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE config_value = VALUES(config_value), description = VALUES(description), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM system_config ORDER BY config_key ASC
